name: Xbrand World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Contested vacant in a six-way Royal Championship Brawl on X-Brand's own debut show; interference from non-entrants Duff Man and Dias Ferreira voided the match, and incoming General Manager The Game suspended the championship on the spot. No reign of record survives in this wing's own captures.

name: ROC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Ring Of Champions' own top title, held by MoonPlague through this wing's own captures; a Summer Bash Triple Threat against Sabão and JakerTombstone was set up on ROC #3 after their own number-one-contender match ended in a double count-out.

name: ROC European Championship
epitaph: Held by Guilty Pleasure on ROC's own champions list of 3 August 2008; no defence survives in this wing's own captures.

name: ROC Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Edge and Diogo X_Day through this wing's own captures; a Summer Bash defence against 619 Tritur and Jesus of Suburbia was set up on ROC #3 after X_Day lost a title-eliminator to 619 Tritur.
